items.label: Premium Material
items.value: The Wood floor lamp is integrated with premium Nature Rubber wood tripod, which is enduring, firm and aesthetic. It’s sturdy design makes it no shaking and safe to have around children and pets

items.label: Stylish Design
items.value: Elevate your space with this stylish mid century floor lamp, featuring a sleek modern design that complements any decor. Its unique three-legged wooden base ensures sturdy stability, while the rounded linen lamp shade adds a touch of elegance and warmth to your home or office. Perfect for creating a cozy, contemporary ambiance

items: Enhance your space with customizable lighting. This fixture features a standard E26 screw base (light not included) for easy installation. For optimal brightness, we recommend using a 10W-12W LED, 12W-20W energy-saving light, or 40W-60W incandescent light to achieve the perfect ambiance
Enjoy effortless control with the convenient foot switch. Easily turn your modern floor lamp on/off without bending down, perfect for hands-free convenience in any room

items.label: Easy-to-Assemble
items.value: The Vintage Floor lamp requires user assembly. Includes Simple DIY Leg and Shade Attachment. (During assembly, please avoid dropping the lamp shade, and avoid violent assembly or violent pulling)

items.value: Wood (for the base) and Linen lampshade)

items.value: Bedroom, Living Room, Nursery, Study Room
